title: Exact faithful comparison on coefficient-sized intrinsic modules
statement: Let X be any scheme in universe u and A any discrete commutative ring in max(v,u+1). On the recorded coefficient-sized etale and pro-etale site models, the canonical constant-coefficient module pullback constructibleComparisonPullback X A preserves finite limits and is faithful. There is no Noetherianity, constructibility, boundedness or nonzero-ring hypothesis.

source.place: Exact fully faithful module comparison; Stacks Tags 00YV (6) and 099T, transported through the recorded coefficient-sized small sites.

proof.text: Construct the pullback presentation of constant set sheaves by uniqueness of the constant-sheaf adjunction and the comparison adjunction. Verify its unit equation first at the terminal object and then on every object by naturality. Commute constant sheafification with the underlying-set functor. This gives a ring presentation whose unit is exactly constructibleComparisonRingMap. The module inverse-image unit comparison identifies the underlying additive sheaf of the intrinsic module pullback with the abelian-sheaf pullback.

The site comparison is representably flat, so its abelian-sheaf inverse image preserves finite limits. The module forgetful functor reflects finite limits. Transport through the proved underlying additive-sheaf comparison to obtain finite-limit preservation of constructibleComparisonPullback.

Repeat the source comparison-unit argument for AddCommGrpCat in universe max(v,u+1): the affine pro-etale Kan extension carries standard cofiltered presentations to filtered colimits, using preservation of limits by maps to etale schemes. Exactness of filtered colimits makes the restriction a sheaf. Density of the affine pro-etale basis and invertibility of the affine etale Kan-extension unit show that the abelian comparison unit is invertible. Its inverse image is therefore faithful. Transport through AsSmall sheaf equivalences using uniqueness of left adjoints; then the underlying additive-sheaf comparison reflects equality of module morphisms.

proof_origin.place: Constructed constant-ring pullback-unit presentation; underlying abelian inverse-image comparison; direct proof of the enlarged-universe additive comparison unit on affine sites. All steps are proved in Lean.

      (constructibleComparisonPullback X A).Faithful
